FN-WX4REE9-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 7
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Security
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/04/2024
Senate Bill 7 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to county or municipal governments
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: (1) the amount of funds
reimbursed by nonpublic schools for the salary, benefits, and other costs associated with
providing a school resource officer to the nonpublic school; and (2) the amount otherwise
reimbursed by the nonpublic schol absent this bill.

Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Security
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/17/2024
Senate Bill 7 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security could
increase receipts to county or municipal governments by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the difference in: (1) the amount of funds reimbursed by nonpublic schools for the salary,
benefits, and other costs associated with providing a school resource officer to the nonpublic
school; and (2) the amount otherwise reimbursed by the nonpublic school absent this bill.
